AxisFeature.description: A construction axis, usable wherever an axis or direction is picked (revolve, patterns…).

BodyOp.description: Body operation shared by solid-producing features.

BodyScope.description: Which existing bodies a solid feature with op add/cut/intersect acts on. Default (`undefined`) = every body the new tool solid touches (Onshape-style "merge scope: all").

propagate.description: M3: extend along tangent-continuous edges. Default true.

angle.description: Total angle spanned. With `equalSpacing` the instances fill it (360° = a full ring).

CopySource.description: What a mirror or pattern copies. `features`: the listed features' **tool shapes** are copied and applied with each feature's own op (a pattern of holes cuts every copy); `bodies`: whole bodies are copied (and merged when `merge`).

DimensionConstraint.description:
Conventions (normative): angles are CCW from `a` to `b`, reference values reported in [0, 2π); `hDistance`/`vDistance` are signed b − a (with `a === b` = a line: end − start); distances to circles/arcs measure to the curve; `diameter` solves as radius = value / 2.

Dimensions. `driving: true` constrains the solver with `value`; `driving: false` is a reference (driven) dimension whose value is **measured** after solving (planegcs non-driving constraints are unreliable — PLAN §3). `label` positions the text in sketch space for display.

DraftFeature.description: Taper faces by `angle` about a neutral plane, along its normal (flip with `reverse`).

propagate.description: M3: extend along tangent-continuous edges (OCCT's behaviour). Default true.

Frame.description: Placement frame: origin plus Z (normal) and X directions. Right-handed; Y = Z × X. Numbers are **millimetres** — the canonical internal length unit for all stored geometry, whatever `WhittleDoc.units` says (units only affect display and unit-less expression input). User-editable offsets belong in feature Exprs.

GeometricConstraint.description: Geometric constraints (no value). Ids refer to entities; points are entities too.

HoleFeature.description: Hole wizard. Holes are placed at sketch points on a planar face (one hole per point), drilled along the face's inward normal. Sizes come from the standards tables (contracts/standards.ts); explicit diameters override them.

diameter.description: Override of the table diameter (drill diameter for tapped holes).

points.description: Sketch points (`S…:p(id)`) or vertices; their sketch must lie on the hole's face.

thread.description: Tapped holes: a cosmetic thread (no helical geometry) over `depth` (default: full).

tipAngle.description: Drill-point cone at a blind end (118° default); omitted = flat bottom.

ImportFeature.description:
A body imported from a file (STEP/IGES/BREP solids, or STL/OBJ/3MF/GLB meshes as reference bodies). The file's bytes live in the project folder at `source.path` (an attachment, e.g. `imports/<featureId>.step`), never inline in the JSON, so documents stay diffable. `sha256` (hex) identifies the bytes for caching and integrity.

Imported faces have no construction history; the regen engine names them `F<id>:face#k` ordered by the deterministic geometric key in naming.ts, and downstream references to them rely on fingerprints when the file is replaced.

frame.description: Placement of the imported geometry (mm); default identity.

direction.description: Edge, axis or plane (its normal) giving the direction; `reverse` flips it.

skip.description: Instance indices (0 = the original) to leave out, row-major with `second`.

LoftFeature.description: Loft through ordered sections (each a closed region, or a point for the first/last).

closed.description: Join the last section back to the first.

guides.description: Optional guide curves (M3: best-effort; OCCT ThruSections ignores them).

ruled.description: Straight (ruled) faces between sections instead of smooth ones.

Material.description: A part's physical material (PLAN §2.2). Stored inline (not by reference only) so documents stay self-contained and diff/merge cleanly; `libraryId` records where it came from so the UI can offer "reset to library values".

appearance.description: Optional appearance hint (CSS hex) used when the part has no explicit `color`.

density.description: Density expression with units, e.g. `"2.70 g/cm^3"`, `"2700 kg/m^3"`, `"0.0975 lb/in^3"`.

libraryId.description: Built-in or user library id, e.g. `"whittle:aluminium-6061-t6"`. Absent for ad-hoc materials.

properties.description: Optional extra properties for later use (FEA etc.), as expressions with units.

plane.description: A plane feature, origin plane or planar face.

color.description: CSS hex colour, e.g. `"#9aa4b2"`. Overrides the material's appearance colour.

material.description: Physical material. Absent = no mass properties beyond volume (UI shows "Assign material").

rollbackIndex.description: Features with index >= rollbackIndex are not evaluated. `features.length` = fully rolled forward.

flip.description: Flip the plane normal (and so the sketch's orientation on it).

PmiAnnotation.description: Model-based definition: becomes STEP AP242 semantic PMI and can be imported into drawings.

value.description: Usually bound to a feature/sketch dimension.

PointFeature.description: A construction point (sketch references, measure, axes and planes).

PrimitiveFeature.description: Solid primitive (box/cylinder/sphere). Used by M0 ("façade makes a box") and kept for quick blocking-out. The box spans [0,dx]×[0,dy]×[0,dz] in `frame` (default: world).

PushPullFeature.description: Direct editing (PLAN §9.2, M2): moves faces of one body along their normal. Positive `distance` moves outward (adds material), negative inward (removes). M2 supports planar faces; others fail with an `UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE` error naming the face. Recorded as a feature, so it is parametric.

ShellFeature.description: Hollow a body: remove `openFaces`, offset the rest by `thickness` (inward by default).

openFaces.description: Faces to remove (on one body). Empty = a closed hollow solid.

SketchArc.description: Counter-clockwise from `start` to `end` around `center` (both on the circle).

construction.description: Construction geometry is solved and constrainable but never forms profiles.

source.description: M3 Convert Entities: a **linked** entity whose geometry is the projection of model geometry onto the sketch plane, recomputed by the regen engine every time (points, lines, arcs and circles; other curves project as an approximating chain of lines marked `approximate`). Linked entities are fixed (no DOF) and can be dimensioned and constrained to. If `ref` no longer resolves, the sketch is "needs attention" (never re-picked silently). Removing `source` unlinks the entity into ordinary geometry.

SketchFeature.description: A 2D sketch on a plane or planar face. Geometry and constraints are defined in `sketch.ts`. The kernel turns the solved sketch into wires and regions (names: see `naming.ts`).

on.description: Plane or planar face the sketch lies on (`origin:XY` etc. or a face/plane-feature ref).

SweepFeature.description: Sweep closed profile regions along a path (a chain of sketch curves or model edges).

orientation.description: `followPath`: the profile turns with the path (Frenet); `fixed`: it keeps its orientation.

ThreadFeature.description: A cosmetic thread on a cylindrical face: an annotation (drawings, PMI), no geometry change.
